Get a Free Companion Ticket Voucher to fly on Etihad Airways to any destination in any class of travel when you spend AED 150,000 in one year with your ADIB Etihad Guest Visa Infinite Card. For more details click here.

Primary cardholder can enjoy complimentary Etihad Guest Silver Tier membership with an option to fast track to Etihad Guest Gold Tier on meeting a minimum spend of AED 4,500 on Etihad Airways within 12 months of card issuance. Applicable only for first year.

As an ADIB Etihad Guest Visa Infinite Cardholder you will also enjoy 1 complimentary class upgrade voucher when you spend AED 350,000 or more in one year. This voucher allows you to upgrade your flight ticket from Economy to Business or from Business to First on any Etihad Airways flight. For more details check here.
Tier Miles on purchase

Purchases with your ADIB Etihad Guest Visa Infinite Covered Card also entitle you to Tier Miles, which help you progress to the next tier as well as maintaining your current tier status within the Etihad Guest program.
Tier Miles will be awarded subject to a maximum of 50,000 Tier Miles annually for Infinite cardholders and will be valid for a 12-month period.
Complimentary Airport lounge access
Complimentary access over 1,000 lounges in more than 300 cities worldwide for cardholder and one guest via through the Visa Airport Companion app. For more details, Click here.
As an ADIB Etihad Guest Visa Infinite card member, you are eligible for playing complimentary golf with one guest at selected locations (capped at once per month).

With your ADIB Covered Card, you can now shop at selected merchants and payback in easy installment payments of 3/6/9/12 months with 100% waiver of Murabaha Monthly Profit and no processing fees by calling 600 543216.
Etihad Guest is Etihad Airways' loyalty programme and one of the fastest-growing travel rewards programmes in the Middle East.

As an Etihad Guest member, you earn Guest Miles on every Etihad flight and on everyday purchases with your ADIB Etihad Guest Visa Infinite Card. Miles can be redeemed for flights, upgrades, hotels, car hire, and experiences across Etihad and its global airline partners.
Etihad Guest has three membership tiers: Infinite, Platinum and Gold. Higher tiers unlock priority check-in, complimentary lounge access at Etihad hubs, bonus miles, and seat upgrades when available.
With the ADIB Etihad Guest Visa Infinite Card, you earn up to 8.75 Miles per AED 10 spent - one of the fastest earn rates available in the UAE.
Spouse covered at 100% of primary cardholder benefit
Dependent children covered at 25% of primary benefit

As a covered card, your ADIB account is funded before spending, ensuring your financial activity remains compliant with Shari'a at all times. Earn Etihad Guest Miles on every eligible purchase, travel the world in style, and stay true to your values.
